The '''481st Experimental Starfighter Testing Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Formed of highly trained [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], the 481st was initially founded during the development of the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]]. Under the command of [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Gareth Agamar]], the 481st was stationed aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Mephitis (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Mephitis'']] near [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]], from where the squadron conducted tests of the [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE/ph phantom]], an Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] fitted with an experimental [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]].
